I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql` rather than editing `001_init.sql`, since 001 has probably already been applied. I haven't run it.

The migration does three things, in this order:
1. It sets existing NULL `status` rows to `'queued'`. Without this, the NOT NULL step would fail on the rows that are already NULL.
2. It sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. It makes the column `NOT NULL`.

The backfill marks every existing NULL-status export as `'queued'`, including any that already ran. If you'd rather give old rows a different status, change the `update` line before you run it.
